title: Alberta tables bill to limit access to the provincial voter list and raise penalties after privacy breach
summary: Alberta tabled a bill on Monday 23 November. It would limit voter list access to parties with an elected member or candidates in more than half of Alberta's ridings, require a $100,000 security deposit, and raise the maximum fine to $1 million from $100,000. Global News reports investigations by RCMP, Elections Alberta and the privacy commissioner continue.
plain: Alberta proposed stricter rules on who can get the voter list and higher fines for misuse, after a privacy breach involving the list.
exec: Parties would need a $100,000 deposit and face a maximum fine of $1 million from $100,000 for misusing Alberta's voter list, under the bill.
